Config.Title: Title
Config.FrameOpacityHint: Opacity of the tile's frame edge. 0 = invisible, 1 = solid. Applies to the Subtle / Framed styles.
Config.BgOpacityHint: 0 = transparent, 1 = solid. Applies to Solid / Frosted / Gradient backgrounds.
Config.UrlHint: Some sites (GitHub, Google, X, most login pages) refuse to be embedded and will stay blank — that's their policy, not a bug. Use the ⇗ button on the tile to open them in a window. Wikis, docs, dashboards and LegendKeeper embed fine.
Config.WebviewZoomHint: 1 = default. Higher zooms the page in; lower shows more of it.
Config.LinkedDocPlaceholder: Actor.xx…  /  JournalEntry.xx…  /  drop one onto the board
Config.LinkedDocHint: The document this tile shows. Usually set by dragging it in; paste a UUID to re-point it.
Config.CardsShowAllLabel: Show every card to all players (ignore ownership)
Config.CardsHint: Drop actors/items on the tile to add cards (duplicates allowed). Drag a card onto the scene to place its token (or a tile, in edit mode). In edit mode: drag to reorder, × to remove.
Config.MeterKindHint: Bar / dial / sliding scale run from the minimum to the maximum. Circle and Token pool count whole units from 0 — there, Maximum is the number of segments or tokens.
Config.MeterTextHint: The label and the numbers can each take their own colour and size. Leave a colour box unticked to use the tile's text colour; size is a multiplier on the automatic tile-relative size (1 = default).
Config.MeterStepHint: Values snap to multiples of this. 0 turns snapping off (smooth). Circle and Token pool always step by 1.
Config.MeterRangeHint: Circle and Token pool ignore the minimum and count whole units from 0; there, Maximum is the number of segments/tokens (up to 512).
Config.MeterIconPlaceholder: e.g. fa-solid fa-heart  (leave blank for none)
Config.MeterIconHint: Circle style only — a Font Awesome icon shown in the middle of the ring, in the fill colour. Pick from the list or type any Font Awesome class Foundry has.
Config.MeterHint: Adjust the meter in normal play (not edit mode): click or drag the gauge/scale, or click a segment or token — clicking the last filled one empties it. Note: non-GMs also need Foundry permission to save changes (e.g. ownership of the landing scene).
Config.HtmlHint: Select text and press Ctrl/⌘+B, I or U to format it. Paste a link over selected text to turn it into a hyperlink.
Config.NoteTextSizeHint: Text size for this note, relative to the tile (1 = default; the note also scales with the tile's size).
Config.NoteFontHint: Pick a font Foundry already knows, or type a Google Font name to load it on demand. A custom name overrides the dropdown. Add more fonts permanently via Foundry's Manage Fonts.

DMScreen.Title: DM Screen
DMScreen.Reorder: Drag to move — beside a tile to share its row, above/below for a new row
DMScreen.Empty: No tools yet. Use + to add a tile.

CastBar.Reveal: Show the Cast Bar to players
CastBar.Empty: Drag characters (from the sidebar or a compendium) here to add Actors.
CastBar.Exit: Exit the conversation (darken — still in the scene)
CastBar.NameToggle: Click to show/hide this name from players
CastBar.ImagePrompt: Which image should this Actor's plate use?

Settings.WorldBadgeHint: A world setting: the GM sets it once and it applies to every player. Settings without this badge only change your own display.

DmTabPad.Name: DM screen tab — edge padding
DmTabPad.Hint: Horizontal gap (px) the DM-screen toggle tab keeps to the left of the sidebar. Increase it to clear other UI docked there, such as a party HUD; negative values push it toward — or over — the sidebar edge.

DmTabTop.Name: DM screen tab — position along edge
DmTabTop.Hint: Where the DM-screen toggle tab sits along its docked edge, as a percentage (0 = start, 50 = middle, 100 = end). For a left/right dock this is vertical; for a top/bottom dock it's horizontal.

MaxWidgetSize.Name: Maximum tile size
MaxWidgetSize.Hint: The largest a tile can be resized to, measured in grid squares (applies to width and height).

LodMinWebviews.Name: Live web views before LOD
LodMinWebviews.Hint: How many web-view tiles may stay live before level-of-detail kicks in. Once the board has at least this many web views AND is zoomed far out, distant web views are shown as a quiet placeholder to save performance. Set high to keep every web view live.

ControlRole.Name: Who can control tiles & cards
ControlRole.Hint: Minimum user role that can add/remove/reorder cards and drop documents to create tiles. Note: non-GMs also need Foundry permission to save changes (e.g. ownership of the landing scene).

DmDock.Name: DM screen position
DmDock.Hint: Which edge the DM screen drawer emerges from. 'Beside the sidebar' keeps Foundry's chat and dice visible; 'Over the sidebar' covers them at the right edge (original behaviour); Left / Top / Bottom emerge from those edges. Also switchable from the gear in the DM screen header.
DmDock.Beside: Right — beside the sidebar (keeps chat/dice visible)

CastBarDock.Name: Cast Bar position
CastBarDock.Hint: Which edge the floating Cast Bar (the character-portrait strip for narrative encounters) centres on. Per-user. It's sized to its Actors, so it never spans the full width or covers the sidebar / chat.

CastBarTabPos.Name: Cast Bar tab — position along edge
CastBarTabPos.Hint: Where the Cast Bar toggle tab sits along its docked edge, as a percentage (0 = start, 50 = middle, 100 = end). For a top/bottom dock this is horizontal; for a left/right dock it's vertical.

CastBarTabPad.Name: Cast Bar tab — edge padding
CastBarTabPad.Hint: Horizontal gap (px) the right-docked Cast Bar toggle tab keeps to the left of the sidebar. Increase it to clear other UI docked there; negative values push it toward — or over — the sidebar edge. (Only affects a right-docked Cast Bar.)

CastBar2Dock.Name: Second Cast Bar
CastBar2Dock.Hint: Add a second, independent Cast Bar on another edge — e.g. the party on one strip and NPCs on the other. Each bar keeps its own roster; 'Off' disables it. GM setting, applied for everyone. (Shares the Actor size / tab settings with the first Cast Bar.)

CastStatAC.Name: Cast Bar stat — Armor Class
CastStatAC.Hint: Allow the AC (shield) stat to be shown on Cast Bar plates. Each plate still starts with its stats hidden — reveal them per-plate from the bar's hover controls.

CastStatPP.Name: Cast Bar stat — Passive Perception
CastStatPP.Hint: Allow the Passive Perception (eye) stat to be shown on Cast Bar plates.

CastStatHP.Name: Cast Bar stat — Current HP
CastStatHP.Hint: Allow the current Hit Points (heart) stat to be shown on Cast Bar plates.

CastStatInv.Name: Cast Bar stat — Passive Investigation
CastStatInv.Hint: Allow the Passive Investigation (mask) stat to be shown on Cast Bar plates.

CastHideInCombat.Name: Hide the Cast Bar during combat
CastHideInCombat.Hint: When a combat encounter is running, hide the Cast Bar(s) — you're usually on tokens/initiative then. Entering Bivouac edit mode still shows it. GM setting, applied for everyone.

CastBarFont.Name: Cast Bar font
CastBarFont.Hint: Font for the Cast Bar's names. Pick one Foundry already knows (including fonts added via Manage Fonts). A custom Google Font below overrides this.

CastBarFontCustom.Name: Cast Bar font — custom (Google Fonts)
CastBarFontCustom.Hint: Type a Google Font name (e.g. Cinzel) to load it on demand and use it for the Cast Bar, overriding the dropdown. Leave blank to use the dropdown. Needs Foundry's CSP to allow fonts.googleapis.com / gstatic.com (standard).

CastBarFontSize.Name: Cast Bar font size
CastBarFontSize.Hint: Scales the Actor name text on the Cast Bar. 1 is the default size (which already scales with the plates); drag up for bigger, down for smaller. Per client.

CastBarSize.Name: Cast Bar — Actor size
CastBarSize.Hint: How large the floating character Actors are, in pixels. Per-user — size them to taste.
